name: 17543 · Lititz, PA
findings: ZIP 17543 (Lititz) has 184 nonprofit organizations. 97 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17543 (Lititz) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17543 (Lititz) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
